carve_outs.why: The notes exclude no part of the product.

bare_supports.why: Every Supports row on a complex criterion shows the work.

author.why: A named outside firm wrote it: Example Audits LLC.

remarks.why: All 2 admissions read like a bug report, and every Supports row on a complex criterion gives an example or the method.

leads.name: Contrast (Minimum)
leads.remarks: On the Gradebook screen, placeholder text in the search field has a 3.1:1 contrast ratio, which users with low vision may not read.

leads.name: Focus Visible
leads.remarks: The equation editor toolbar shows no focus indicator, so keyboard users cannot tell which button is selected.

flags: The extraction found 11 WCAG Level A and AA rows. WCAG 2.1 has 50, so the analyst checks for rows the report or the extraction missed.
